# Sirach Chapter 50 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Codex Vaticanus, Sirach 50 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-DC/SIR_050_page_001.jpg

---

**50:1** Simon son of Onias the priest, who in his life repaired the house and in his days fortified the temple.

**50:2** He laid the foundations of the double height, the high walls of the enclosure of the temple.

**50:3** In his days a cistern for water was hewn out, a reservoir like the sea in circumference.

**50:4** He was concerned for his people against plunderers and strengthened his city against enemies.

**50:5** How glorious he was, surrounded by the people, as he came out from behind the curtain of the temple!

**50:6** Like the morning star among the clouds, like the full moon on festival days,

**50:7** like the sun shining upon the temple of the Most High, like the rainbow gleaming in glorious clouds,

**50:8** like a flower of roses in the days of the first fruits, like lilies at a spring of water, like a sprig of frankincense in the time of summer,

**50:9** like fire and incense in the censer, like a vessel of hammered gold adorned with all kinds of precious stones,

**50:10** like an olive tree heavy with fruit, like a cypress rising high among the clouds,

**50:11** when he put on his glorious robe and clothed himself with the completion of glory, as he went up to the holy altar, he glorified the enclosure of the sanctuary.

**50:12** And when he received the portions from the hands of the priests, and he himself stood at the hearth of the altar, his brothers all around him like a wreath, he was like a young cedar of Lebanon surrounded by the trunks of palm trees.

**50:13** And all the sons of Aaron in their glory, with the fire offerings of the Lord in their hands, before all the congregation of Israel.

**50:14** Until he finished the service of the altar and arranged the offering of the Most High the Almighty,

**50:15** he stretched out his hand to the libation cup and poured out from the blood of the grape; he poured out at the foot of the altar a pleasing aroma to the Most High, the King of all.

**50:16** Then the sons of Aaron shouted and sounded on metal trumpets, and made a great sound heard as a reminder before the Most High.

**50:17** Then all the people together hastened and fell upon their faces upon the ground to worship before the Most High, before the Holy One of Israel.

**50:18** And the sound of the singing resounded, and over the great multitude the sound was made sweet.

**50:19** And all the people of the land prayed and petitioned before the merciful Lord until the worship of the Lord was completed, and they finished his service.

**50:20** Then he came down and lifted up his hands over all the congregation of Israel; and the blessing of the Lord was on his lips, and in the name of the Lord he glorified himself.

**50:21** And they bowed down a second time to receive the blessing from the Most High.

**50:22** And now bless the God of all, who in every way does great things; who exalts our days from the womb and deals with us according to his mercy.

**50:23** May he give us gladness of heart, and let there be peace in our days in Israel, and the faithfulness of Israel may remain forever.

**50:24** May his mercy remain with us, and may he deliver us in our days!

**50:25** With two nations my soul is vexed, and the third is no nation at all:

**50:26** those who live on Mount Seir and the Philistines, and the foolish people that dwell in Shechem.

**50:27** Instruction in understanding and knowledge I have written in this book — I, Jesus son of Sirach, son of Eleazar, of Jerusalem — who poured out understanding like rain.

**50:28** Blessed is he who meditates on these things, and he who lays them to heart will become wise.

**50:29** For if he does them, he will be strong in all things; for the light of the Lord is his path.
